Yes!

Take the magic e off cape.

hop + magic e is… hopp, or hope, or hoop
The e in cape is… said /e/, or silent — it wakes a, or a blend
Which pair is a magic-e switch? fox / box, or cap / cape, or ship / shop
bone (the dog's bone) has… short o, or long o, or silent o
kit without a change is short. kite is… still short i, or long i, or a new consonant
